This multi-category damage sustained over two days almost certainly exceeds $25,000 in remediation, drying, flooring replacement, drywall repair, and content replacement, requiring urgent adjuster attention.

input.claim_summary: Homeowner returned from work trip to find basement flooded with approximately two inches of water from a burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink that ran for about two days.
